description: This file is a module defining manipulation functions for jQuery, including DOM cloning, removal, and content insertion, with dependencies on other jQuery modules.

methods.name: manipulationTarget
methods.description: Determines the appropriate container element for inserting new rows, preferring tbody over table.

methods.name: disableScript
methods.description: Temporarily disables script elements by changing their type attribute.

methods.name: restoreScript
methods.description: Restores script elements' type attribute to re-enable them.

methods.name: cloneCopyEvent
methods.description: Copies event handlers and private data from source to destination element.

methods.name: fixInput
methods.description: Fixes issues with cloned input elements, preserving checked state and default values.

methods.name: domManip
methods.description: Performs DOM manipulation tasks like inserting, cloning, and executing scripts.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes elements from the DOM, optionally cleaning data.
